# Trigger soak. engine-soak-test and the AHK --self-test play every scenario
# on software and on a board, on the profile in soak-profile.json (a trimmed
# copy of real configs), one tick per millisecond.
#
#   scenario <name> <front exe>    a new run: fingers up, no runners
#   down <key> <ms> / up <key> <ms>
#   hold <key> <ms> <length>       down, then up after length
#   holdr <key> <ms> <length>      hold with Windows key repeat: 500 ms, then every 33 ms
#   taps <key> <ms> <down> <gap> <count>
#   push <ms>                      a profile push: the same document again
#   focus <ms> <exe>               the front window changes
#   end <ms>
#
# soak-expected.txt is the summary both engines must print.

# Jump: whileHeld block, releaseStop finish. Fast taps, 40 ms down, 40 ms up.
scenario ow-jump-taps Overwatch.exe
taps LWin 100 40 40 20
end 2500

# A re-press 3 to 33 ms after the release, while the last pass finishes.
# Every one plays on while held: the runner loops or starts as held-press.
scenario ow-jump-repress Overwatch.exe
down LWin 100
up LWin 700
down LWin 703
up LWin 1300
down LWin 1308
up LWin 1900
down LWin 1915
up LWin 2500
down LWin 2525
up LWin 3100
down LWin 3133
up LWin 3700
end 4200

# Long holds, and two triggers overlapping. Reload 10 s, New macro 5 s, Jump 3 s.
scenario ow-long Overwatch.exe
holdr a 100 10000
holdr v 200 5000
holdr LWin 3000 3000
end 10600

# A profile push mid-hold keeps Jump playing. A press that lands with the
# push still starts Reload.
scenario ow-push Overwatch.exe
holdr LWin 100 3000
push 1500
down a 1500
up a 2000
push 2600
end 3600

# A focus switch mid-hold stops Jump. Focus comes back with LWin still
# held: no restart. The next press plays.
scenario ow-focus Overwatch.exe
hold LWin 100 3000
focus 1000 explorer.exe
focus 1500 Overwatch.exe
hold LWin 3300 500
end 4300

# Ability: Run Once with a onceHeld block. Taps during the run.
scenario ow-ability Overwatch.exe
taps r 100 30 60 8
hold r 1200 2000
end 3800

# Simple Edit: whileHeld with a onceHeld block. A re-press 25 ms after the
# release lands in its 85 ms gap and plays as held-press.
scenario fn-simple-edit FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe
hold b 100 300
hold b 425 1000
taps b 1700 30 30 10
hold b 2500 2000
end 5000

# Wall on mouse 5 (whileHeld block, finish), Cone and Ramp (steps, nextUp),
# Floor (whileHeld block, nextUp) overlapping.
scenario fn-build FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe
hold XButton2 100 3000
holdr LShift 500 4000
holdr CapsLock 1000 2000
taps XButton2 3500 40 40 10
holdr t 4000 3000
end 7500

# Run Once stratagems on side buttons and keys: a tap, a tap during the pass
# (ignored), a hold with repeats (one pass).
scenario hd-run-once helldivers2.exe
hold XButton1 100 50
hold XButton1 300 50
hold XButton1 1500 3000
taps 4 5000 30 300 3
holdr LWin 6500 3000
end 10000

# Supply Car: whileHeld steps, finish. A re-press inside its 450 ms pass.
scenario hd-supply helldivers2.exe
holdr 3 100 1000
holdr 3 1150 2000
end 3800
